request: how does the call stack work during recursion?

composition.story: Recursive calls pile up on the call stack, allocating local variables until the base case stops the growth and unwinds.

aha.observation: At the base case, stacking stops and execution reverses to return and pop frames.

states.label: Call f(3)
states.sentence: Function f(3) is called and pushed to the stack.
states.why: Initial call starts the stacking process.

states.label: Call f(2)
states.sentence: f(3) calls f(2), pushing a second frame.
states.why: Each recursive call adds a new layer.

states.label: Base Case f(1)
states.sentence: f(2) calls f(1), hitting the base case.
states.why: The base case halts further recursion.

states.label: Return & Pop
states.sentence: f(1) returns, and the stack begins popping frames.
